'''2014 European Championship Reset Beta Markus Fink LS Rebel Strike Team''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Markus Fink]] at [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Markus Fink]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed|Endor-L-rebelstriketeam.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Heading For The Medical Frigate]]
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2014-europeans-reset-beta-event-14th-place-ls-markus-fink-rst/ PC list]
